headline: The documentation settles on one spelling of the words it uses in both.
summary: The changelog carried British spellings of behaviour, recognise and labelled while every other document in the repository used the US forms, so a reader searching for one form missed entries written in the other. The entries are generated from the release notes, so the spelling is corrected at that source and the changelog is rebuilt from it. No entry changes what it says.

Changed: Changelog entries now use the US spellings behavior, recognize, unrecognized and labeled, matching the README, the roadmap and the security policy. Seventeen occurrences across eleven release notes. One British spelling remains on purpose: RFC 8894 is titled Simple Certificate Enrolment Protocol, and a standard's title is quoted as published.
